texts.preamble: Matte Madhu vs The State Of Telanana on 12 June, 2025 Author: N. Tukaramji Bench: N. Tukaramji The Honourable Sri Justice N. Tukaramji Criminal Petition No.6897 of 2025 Order:
texts.facts: This Criminal Petition is filed under Section 528 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 (for short 'BNSS, 2023') seeking quashment of the proceedings, against the petitioners/A1 and A2 in Cr.No.201 of 2025 of Hasanparthy Police Station, Warangal District. 2. The petitioners are arrayed as accused Nos.1 and 2 in Cr.No.201 of 2025 registered for the offences punishable under Sections 272 and 275 of BNS. The prosecution case in brief is that the petitioners/accused Nos.1 and 2 are involved in selling and purchasing the banned Tobacco products and the Police concerned has seized the said Tobacco products worth of Rs.3,00,000/- from the possession of the petitioners. 8. As per the prosecution, on 10.05.2025, the complainant/Sub Inspector of Police lodged a complaint alleging that while conducting vehicle checking at Vangapahad cross road (ORR) at 17:30 hours the petitioner NTR,J No.1 was proceedings to Hyderabad side in a car in a suspicious manner, the police apprehended him and seized two bags containing 15000 sachets of Government banned Tobacco i.e., Ambar Tobacco packets worth Rs.3,00,000/- along with car from his possession, on Matte Madhu vs The State Of Telanana on 12 June, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/189656634/ Thereafter, the Director General of Police, Telangana State issued Circular Memorandum in RC.No. 295/R1-NS/2022 with directions to the Station NTR,J House Officers not to interfere with the business activities, who carry out the business as per rules of Food Safety and Standards Authority of India and also not to take any coercive measures against the tobacco traders as long as the order of the Hon'ble Supreme Court is in force.
texts.arguments: Learned counsel for the petitioners would submit that this Court vide Criminal Petition No.6235 of 2022, on considering similar allegations and the merits, [LEAKAGE_MASK] the proceedings against the petitioners therein. He further submits that the 2nd respondent has registered the present crime in violation of the orders passed by this Court. Hence, prayed for quashment of the proceedings against the petitioners in the crime. 6. Learned Additional Public Prosecutor would submit that the petitioners have been found with the Tobacco products and investigation is pending. However, fairly admitted that in the authority cited by the petitioners in the similar circumstances, the proceedings against the petitioners therein were [LEAKAGE_MASK].
